is_anopheles.evidence: The review discusses Anopheles mosquitoes (e.g. Page 1: 'described the role of Anopheles mosquitoes in the human malaria cycle').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The article mentions knockdown resistance and metabolic resistance mechanisms conceptually (Page 8), but does not report or genotype any target resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No primary genotype counts, allele frequencies, or mosquito sample sizes are presented.

african_field_population.evidence: No field collections of mosquitoes were conducted for this study.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a review article, explicitly marked as 'REVIEW' on Page 1 ('Disease vectors in the era of next generation sequencing').

sub_country_location.evidence: No field collection locations are reported.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No primary field collection dates are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Review article with no original empirical dataset.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data containing empirical genotype results exists.

assessment.summary: This is a review article describing the applications and opportunities of next-generation sequencing (NGS) in studying vector biology and disease transmission. It presents no primary empirical data on insecticide-resistance markers in field Anopheles populations.
exclusion_reasons: This is a review paper rather than a primary empirical study.
No target insecticide resistance markers are genotyped.
No extractable genotype data are presented.
No African field-collected mosquito populations are tested.
